title: The Old Man and the Sea
author: Ernest Hemingway
summary: An aging Cuban fisherman who has gone eighty-four days without a catch rows far out into the Gulf and hooks an enormous marlin, beginning a three-day struggle of endurance.
readIf: you want a spare, meditative short novel about dignity, effort and stubborn pride.
skipIf: you want dialogue, a large cast or much happening.

pairings.reason: The huge, ornate counterpart: another man against a great sea creature, on an epic scale.
Another survival story at sea that doubles as a meditation on faith and endurance.
A simpler, younger survival story of a lone person against nature.
